claims: Commit d0eb42d42d5d4bd3f18d883eb26b2eb3806e2c72 governs OD-012 R3, aa989146bdaef29a6ac2d6ae2c31ec26ca32d2eb supplies its RED tests, and 541a0b000a2946876831ee1e1650af7e7de6efea supplies the GREEN implementation.
After restart, the MCP tool exposed malleus.cc002.acquire-result/v3 with artifact_count, built_artifact_count, and derivation_record_sha256.

The about-80-second cc002_acquire attempt processed the LinkML and linkml-runtime roots, deterministic ANTLR built root, and /built/prefixcommons-0.1.12+malleus.1-py3-none-any.whl before transitive wheel resolution failed.

The governed error began '[CC002_SUBPROCESS] transitive wheel resolution failed with 1'; pip 25.0.1 reached ResolutionImpossible, but the retained text does not identify the exact conflicting dependency edge.

The diagnostic contains only generic LinkML conflict text and a candidate list ending '[truncated]' because _subprocess_diagnostic retains the first 4096 characters rather than pip's later conflict explanation.
The failed attempt left compiler_environment absent and removed every bounded .cc002-* staging path, so no partial environment was published.
Before the real attempt, 394 environment tests, 104 focused governance tests, and 1628 full-repository tests passed with 2 skips.
This failure exposes a diagnostic observability defect and an unresolved later dependency closure. It does not reopen OD-012 R3 or select a dependency change; CC-002 remains ACTIVE under OVR-000085.
limitations: This verifies failed-closed v3 execution progress, diagnostic loss, and cleanup, not a retained root, complete runtime closure, offline verification, final candidate, or CC-002 completion.
The exact dependency conflict remains unknown. No dependency edge, package, version, or remediation may be inferred from the generic LinkML conflict text.
The successful root processing was observed before staging cleanup and is not retained evidence of final reproducible artifacts.
The raw MCP transcript is not retained. The immutable report records the observed result and binds the previously governed CC-002 manifest bytes.
No diagnostic implementation change or dependency-policy decision is made by this verified fact.

summary: Verify the real v3 CC-002 attempt, diagnostic truncation, and unresolved dependency closure.
why: The real acquisition proves that the R3 implementation loads, processes every governed root, and fails atomically at a later resolver step. Recording exactly what the returned diagnostic proves, what its prefix truncation conceals, and which choices remain unmade keeps progress and dependency planning queryable without inferring a conflict edge or altering OD-012.
